searchText: cc <@466006586477772831> <@531934490826768418> the multi-day peerDAS run strikes again 😄 prysm-geth suffered from the mem-leak and then went offline. Here are the logs as well as the pprof dump in one URL 🙂 https://drive.google.com/file/d/1P2zX9-JV3wWP_w6kkUXZehMXds-Akkz8/view?usp=sharing (it was fine for 3d and then failed on the ~4th day). Network is still at 75% and finalizing. what's the mix for this devnet? its prysm, teku, lh, grandine OK for the mem leak, thanks I'll check. Could you restart the prysm-geth? It should sync back. Sure! I'll start a new run with updated configs tho It is possible to just `docker restart` the stopped containers? To check is sync works normally. IMO Prysm memory leak is not a blocker for the next devnet. We can go with it, but the Prysm node will "just" crash twice a week, then they will restart and resync to the head. If the net is still finalising, that should be a good test for prysm really Even if the network is not finalizing Before spinning a new network
